card.name: Inside rare names and brand names
card.fires_on: The final pieces of rare surnames and of brand drug names split into several parts, such as the K in OLINVYK or the land in McClelland.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: The last letter or piece of a coined brand name, such as OLINVYK or ZEGFROVY.
modes.example: Inspect OLINVY<<K>> for particulate matter and discoloration

modes.label: Uncommon surnames
modes.description: A later piece of a long or foreign surname, often in older or scientific text.

card.plain: It fires on the closing piece of unusual names, whether a rare surname or a new brand drug name.
